segments.label: Launch & ascent — Cape Canaveral SFS SLC-41
segments.note: ULA Vulcan Centaur (VC2S) from Cape Canaveral SFS SLC-41 (28.583°, -80.583°); ~9 min analytic ascent to a 185 km parking orbit (schematic arc, real pad and launch time).

segments.label: Parking orbit coast
segments.note: Circular 185 km parking orbit, inclination 54.2° (plane through the pad at launch and the Moon at arrival — the launch-window geometry). Coast 40 min to the injection burn.

segments.label: Lunar-distance loop & re-entry (apogee ≈393,000 km)
segments.note: Peregrine was injected onto a lunar-distance ellipse; the propellant leak ~7 h after separation ruled out landing, the spacecraft reached ~390,000 km (lunar distance) around Jan 12–13 and Astrobotic steered it to burn up over the South Pacific on Jan 18. One Kepler loop is drawn between the published injection and re-entry times — the real trajectory included several small burns during the loop.
